_comment: The launcher's pages and how an app with no place of its own finds one.
LunaCE's launcher has four built-in pages (apps, downloads, favorites, prefs) and reads
/etc/palm/launcher3/app-keywords-to-designator-map.txt for their display names and for a
keyword-to-page map; AppMonitor::pageDesignatorForWebOSApp tries an app's category first,
then each of its keywords. The reference TouchPad's own map renames favorites to GAMES and
prefs to SETTINGS, and maps webOS Archive's wosa-settings keyword to prefs.
webOS also shipped /etc/palm/default-launcher-page-layout.json, which is what put Palm's
own settings apps on the prefs page. Lunacy has no such layout - it has no fixed set of
apps - so the keywords those apps already carry do the same job here.
